text:
```artifact
Feature: Lab Management System

  Scenario: Lab In-charge views open lab-requests and updates status
    Given the lab-in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab-in-charge views the lab-requests
    Then the lab-in-charge should see the open lab-requests
    And the lab-in-charge should have the option to update the status
    And the status update should be offline

  Scenario: Patient views and prints Prescription and Invoice
    Given the patient is logged in
    And there is a Prescription for the patient
    When the patient views the Prescription
    Then the patient should see the Prescription
    And the patient should have the option to print the invoice
    And the invoice should be printed offline
    And the admin can print and email the Prescription and Invoice

  Scenario: Patient views and prints Prescription and Invoice
    Given the patient is logged in
    And there is a Prescription for the patient
    When the patient views the Prescription
    Then the patient should see the Prescription
    And the patient should have the option to print the invoice
    And the invoice should be printed offline
    And the admin can print and email the Prescription and Invoice

  Scenario: Quarterly archiving of Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
    Given the system is running
    And there are Patient Profiles without Consultation Requests for the last 3 years
    And there are Consultation Requests more than 3 years old
    When the system runs the quarterly archiving process
    Then the Patient Profiles should be archived
    And the Consultation Requests should be archived
```
